verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace, so in-product AI-generated insights (for example spend or GPU recommendations) are a fair axis, but the evidence shows no such feature. `lium spend` reports burn rate and runway and rent-by-spec picks the cheapest matching node; both are deterministic tooling, not AI-generated suggestions. The docs MCP server lets an external agent query docs and prices, which is adjacent rather than in-product AI insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
